marks.gloss_en: as the metzora's shaving overrides the hakafa prohibition, so any aseh overrides a lav
the metzora's purification shaving overrides the prohibition of rounding the head
מה ללאו דהקפה שכן לאו שאין שוה בכל -- the hakafa prohibition does not bind women, so nothing follows for prohibitions binding everyone
if 'זקנו' is not needed for a lav not equally binding, refer it to a lav equally binding -- so an aseh overrides even a lav binding on all
even a priest who is a metzora shaves his beard, against the priests' beard prohibition
ואכתי איצטריך -- the word is not free: it must teach that even for priests, laden with extra mitzvot, the aseh overrides; no אם אינו ענין transfer is possible
'זקנו' is needed to teach that even for priests, given their extra mitzvot, the aseh overrides a lav not equally binding -- so the word is not free for אם אינו ענין
as the metzora's shaving overrides the nazirite razor prohibition, so any aseh overrides a lav
even a metzora who is a nazir shaves, against the nazirite razor prohibition
מה לנזיר שכן ישנו בשאלה -- the nazirite's prohibition can be dissolved by a Sage, so it is weak and nothing follows for ordinary prohibitions
